words.definition: adj. 狡猾的，狡诈的；精巧的；n. 狡诈

examples.en: In the fable, the cunning fox tricks the crow into singing.
examples.zh: 寓言里，狡猾的狐狸骗乌鸦开口唱歌。

examples.en: The police uncovered a cunning scheme to smuggle antiques.
examples.zh: 警方破获了一起走私文物的狡诈阴谋。

words.usage: 形容词兼名词，多含贬义：as cunning as a fox 狐狸般狡猾；也可指精巧：a cunning device 精巧的装置。名词指狡诈（手段）。比较级 more cunning

confusables.note: n. 跑步，双写字母对应

collocations: a cunning plan 狡诈的计划
as cunning as a fox 狐狸般狡猾
a cunning device 精巧的装置
words.mnemonic: can(能)+n+ing → 什么都能算计 → 狡猾的

words.definition: vt. 用拳猛击；打孔；n. 一拳；感染力

examples.en: He punched the wall in a fit of anger.
examples.zh: 他一怒之下捶向墙壁。

examples.en: The conductor punched our tickets before the train departed.
examples.zh: 火车发车前，列车员在车票上打了孔。

words.usage: 及物动词，punch sb on the nose 一拳打在鼻子上；punch a ticket 打孔检票；pack a punch 力道十足；punch line 笑点、点睛之笔。名词指一拳、打孔器

confusables.note: n. 一串，b 与 p 互换

collocations: throw a punch 挥拳
punch a ticket 检票打孔
pack a punch 劲头十足
words.mnemonic: 谐音「砰哧」——拳头带风声 → 用拳猛击；打孔

words.definition: n. 泥，泥浆；诽谤（俚）

examples.en: After the storm, the fields were buried in mud.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后，田地被埋在泥泞之中。

examples.en: His boots were caked with mud from the construction site.
examples.zh: 他的靴子上结满了工地的泥块。

words.usage: 不可数名词，泥、泥浆：be covered in mud 沾满泥；习语 sling mud at sb 诽谤某人、drag sb's name through the mud 玷污名声；mudslide 泥石流
collocations: be covered in mud 沾满泥
sling mud at sb 诽谤某人
mud flats 泥滩
words.mnemonic: mud 与 muddy 一家：乌黑的稀泥 → 泥浆

words.definition: n. 低语，咕哝；潺潺声；v. 低声说

examples.en: A murmur of approval ran through the audience.
examples.zh: 听众中响起一阵低低的赞同声。

examples.en: The stream murmured softly as it flowed over the stones.
examples.zh: 小溪流过卵石，发出轻柔的潺潺声。

words.usage: 可数名词兼动词，指低而连续的声音：a murmur of approval 低声赞同；murmur about sth 私下抱怨；医学 heart murmur 心脏杂音。比 whisper 更轻更含糊
collocations: a murmur of approval 低声赞同
murmur about sth 小声抱怨
without a murmur 毫无怨言
words.mnemonic: murmur 拟声：模模糊糊的嗡嗡声 → 低语

words.definition: n. 局，司，办事处；五斗柜

examples.en: The Federal Bureau of Investigation launched an inquiry into the case.
examples.zh: 联邦调查局对该案展开调查。

examples.en: She kept her winter clothes in an old oak bureau.
examples.zh: 她把冬衣放在一个旧橡木五斗柜里。

words.usage: 可数名词，复数 bureaus 或 bureaux。美式指政府局、处：the Federal Bureau of Investigation；英式兼指五斗柜。派生 bureaucrat 官僚

confusables.note: n. 兽穴，双 r 双 o

synonyms.note: n. 部门，政府公司通用

collocations: the tax bureau 税务局
a bureau drawer 五斗柜抽屉
the Federal Bureau of Investigation 联邦调查局
words.mnemonic: 法语借词，原指桌面呢布 → 办公桌 → 局

words.definition: n. 服务员，侍者；adj. 伴随的

examples.en: The flight attendant demonstrated the safety procedures before take-off.
examples.zh: 起飞前空乘演示了安全程序。

examples.en: Every new technology carries attendant risks.
examples.zh: 每项新技术都伴随着相应的风险。

words.usage: 可数名词，服务人员：flight attendant 空乘；形容词常作定语「伴随的」：attendant risks 随之而来的风险、attendant on 伴随。注意 attendee 是出席者

synonyms.note: n. 乘务管理员，交通场站

collocations: flight attendant 空中乘务员
attendant risks 伴随的风险
a museum attendant 博物馆管理员
words.mnemonic: attend(照料)+ant(人) → 在旁伺候者 → 服务员

words.definition: n. 曲线，弯道；v. （使）弯曲

examples.en: The road follows a gentle curve along the coast.
examples.zh: 公路沿着海岸蜿蜒成一道缓弯。

examples.en: The government promised to flatten the curve of infections.
examples.zh: 政府承诺拉平感染曲线。

words.usage: 可数名词，曲线、弯道：a sharp curve 急弯、the learning curve 学习曲线；动词（使）弯曲：curve around 沿弯延伸。throw sb a curve（美俚）突然刁难

confusables.note: vt. 遏制，b 与 v 之差
vt. 雕刻，a 与 u 之差

collocations: a sharp curve 急弯
learning curve 学习曲线
throw sb a curve 突然刁难
words.mnemonic: curv(弯)：像河道弯弯 → 曲线；使弯曲

words.definition: n. 官僚体制；官僚作风，文牍主义

examples.en: Small firms often struggle with needless bureaucracy.
examples.zh: 小企业常苦于不必要的官僚程序。

examples.en: The project was delayed for months by bloated bureaucracy.
examples.zh: 臃肿的官僚体制使项目拖了数月。

words.usage: 不可数名词，常含贬义：bloated bureaucracy 臃肿的官僚机构；cut through bureaucracy 破除文牍主义。词根 bureau（局）+cracy；派生 bureaucrat 官僚

synonyms.note: n. 官样文章，口语贬义

collocations: bloated bureaucracy 臃肿的官僚机构
cut through bureaucracy 破除官僚作风
government bureaucracy 政府官僚体制
words.mnemonic: bureau(局)+cracy(统治) → 局里说了算 → 官僚作风

words.definition: n. 大杯，马克杯；傻瓜；v. 行凶抢劫

examples.en: He warmed his hands around a mug of hot tea.
examples.zh: 他捧着一大杯热茶暖手。

examples.en: She was mugged on her way home late at night.
examples.zh: 她深夜回家路上遭人抢劫。

words.usage: 可数名词，带柄大杯：a mug of tea 一大杯茶；美俚动词指行凶抢劫：get mugged 被抢；mug shot 警方存档大头照。英式 mug up 临时抱佛脚

confusables.note: adj. 自得的，加一个 s

synonyms.note: n. 杯子，通用带柄小杯

collocations: a mug of tea 一大杯茶
get mugged 遭抢劫
mug shot 警方存档照
words.mnemonic: mug 谐音「马克」→ 马克杯；俚语引申抢劫

words.definition: vt. 猛拧，猛扯；n. 扳手；离别的痛苦

examples.en: He wrenched the door open with all his strength.
examples.zh: 他用尽全力猛地拉开了门。

examples.en: Parting from her family was a painful wrench.
examples.zh: 与家人分别令她痛苦不舍。

words.usage: 及物动词，猛拧、猛扯：wrench sth from one's grasp 从手中猛夺；throw a wrench in the works 从中作梗。名词指扳手（英式 spanner）、离别之痛

confusables.note: n. 可怜虫，t 与 n 之差

collocations: wrench sth from 从…猛夺
throw a wrench in the works 从中作梗
a monkey wrench 活动扳手
words.mnemonic: w(哑音)+rench 谐音「抡扯」→ 猛拧；扳手

words.definition: n. 一串，一束；一群，一帮

examples.en: He bought a bunch of grapes at the market.
examples.zh: 他在集市上买了一串葡萄。

examples.en: A bunch of volunteers showed up to clean the beach.
examples.zh: 一群志愿者前来清理海滩。

words.usage: 可数名词，a bunch of grapes 一串葡萄、a bunch of kids 一群孩子（口语）；the best of the bunch 一批中最好的。口语副词 thanks a bunch 多谢
collocations: a bunch of flowers 一束花
a bunch of keys 一串钥匙
the best of the bunch 一批中最佳
words.mnemonic: bun(小圆面包)+ch：一串小面包 → 一束

words.definition: n. 卷发，卷曲物；v. （使）卷曲，蜷缩

examples.en: The cat curled up on the sofa and fell asleep.
examples.zh: 猫蜷在沙发上睡着了。

examples.en: A curl of smoke rose from the chimney.
examples.zh: 一缕青烟从烟囱袅袅升起。

words.usage: 名词指卷发、卷曲物；动词（使）卷曲、缭绕：curl up 蜷缩、curl one's lip 撇嘴（轻蔑）、a curl of smoke 一缕烟。make one's hair curl 令人发指

confusables.note: vt. 遏制，b 与 l 之差

collocations: curl up 蜷缩
curl one's lip 撇嘴（轻蔑）
a curl of smoke 一缕烟
words.mnemonic: curl 与 curve 同族：弯弯曲曲 → 卷曲；卷发

words.definition: n. 沼泽；vt. 淹没；使应接不暇

examples.en: Heavy rains turned the dirt road into a swamp.
examples.zh: 大雨把土路变成了一片泥沼。

examples.en: The relief agency was swamped with applications for aid.
examples.zh: 救援机构收到的援助申请令其应接不暇。

words.usage: 可数或不可数名词，沼泽（地）；动词多用被动：be swamped with work 忙得不可开交、be swamped by debts 深陷债务。近义 marsh 草本沼泽，swamp 多林木积水
collocations: be swamped with work 忙得不可开交
drain the swamp 排干沼泽
a tropical swamp 热带沼泽
words.mnemonic: s+wamp：洼地积水泥泞 → 淹没；沼泽

words.definition: n. 循环，周期；自行车；v. 骑车

examples.en: The economy seems locked in a cycle of boom and bust.
examples.zh: 经济似乎陷入了繁荣与萧条的循环。

examples.en: She cycles to work to reduce her carbon footprint.
examples.zh: 她骑车上班，以减少碳足迹。

words.usage: 可数名词，循环、周期：life cycle 生命周期、business cycle 经济周期；不及物动词骑自行车（英式）。词根 cycl（圆环），同族 bicycle、cyclone
collocations: life cycle 生命周期
business cycle 商业周期
cycle to work 骑车通勤
words.mnemonic: cycl(环) → 转了一圈又一圈 → 循环；骑车

words.definition: n. （入室）窃贼，夜盗

examples.en: A burglar broke into the warehouse and stole the electronics.
examples.zh: 窃贼破门闯入仓库，偷走了电子产品。

examples.en: The burglar alarm went off at midnight.
examples.zh: 防盗警报午夜响了起来。

words.usage: 可数名词，指破门（窗）入室的窃贼；动词美式 burglarize、英式 burgle；派生 burglary n. 入室盗窃罪。对照 robber 当面抢劫、thief 泛指小偷
collocations: burglar alarm 防盗警报器
catch a burglar 抓获窃贼
burglar-proof 防盗的
words.mnemonic: burglary 去掉 y 加 -ar → 入室行窃的人 → 窃贼

words.definition: n. 木偶，玩偶；傀儡

examples.en: The children laughed at the puppet show in the park.
examples.zh: 孩子们被公园里的木偶戏逗笑了。

examples.en: Historians regard the regime as a puppet government.
examples.zh: 历史学家视该政权为傀儡政府。

words.usage: 可数名词，木偶、玩偶：puppet show 木偶戏；喻受操纵者：a puppet government 傀儡政府、puppet regime 傀儡政权。派生 puppeteer 操纵木偶的人

confusables.note: n. 幼犬，双 p 呼应

synonyms.note: n. 傀儡名义领袖，喻义

collocations: a puppet government 傀儡政府
puppet show 木偶戏
pull the puppet strings 幕后牵线
words.mnemonic: pup(小狗)+pet(宠物) → 被人牵着走 → 木偶；傀儡

words.definition: n. 铁锈，锈；v. 生锈，锈蚀

examples.en: The old gate was covered with rust after years of neglect.
examples.zh: 年久失修，旧大门锈迹斑斑。

examples.en: Bare iron will rust quickly in moist air.
examples.zh: 裸铁在潮湿空气中很快生锈。

words.usage: 不可数名词，铁锈：be covered with rust 锈迹斑斑；动词生锈、锈蚀：rust away 锈蚀殆尽。谚语 Better wear out than rust out 与其锈坏不如用坏

synonyms.note: v. 失去光泽，金属表面

collocations: be covered with rust 锈迹斑斑
rust away 锈蚀殆尽
rust prevention 防锈
words.mnemonic: rust 与 rest 一字之差：久放就生锈

words.definition: n. 树干；躯干；后备箱

examples.en: The hollow trunk of the ancient oak sheltered dozens of birds.
examples.zh: 古橡树空心的树干里栖着数十只鸟。

examples.en: Put the suitcases in the trunk before we set off.
examples.zh: 出发前把手提箱放进后备箱。

words.usage: 可数名词，一词多义：树干（即 stem）、后备箱（英式称 boot）、躯干（即 torso）、象鼻、大旅行箱。派生 truncate vt. 截断
collocations: the trunk of a tree 树干
an elephant's trunk 象鼻
swimming trunks 泳裤
words.mnemonic: trunk 原义「粗管子」：树干、躯干、后备箱都像管

words.definition: adj. 无情的，残忍的；坚决的

examples.en: The regime was ruthless in suppressing any form of dissent.
examples.zh: 该政权无情镇压任何形式的异见。

examples.en: Competition in the industry is intense and utterly ruthless.
examples.zh: 该行业竞争激烈且毫不留情。

words.usage: 形容词，无情的、残忍的：a ruthless dictator 冷酷的独裁者；亦指坚决的：ruthless efficiency 雷厉风行。古词 ruth 怜悯+less 无；派生 ruthlessly 无情地

confusables.note: adj. 坐不住的，音形皆近

collocations: ruthless competition 残酷竞争
a ruthless dictator 冷酷独裁者
be ruthless in 对…毫不手软
words.mnemonic: ruth(怜悯)+less(无) → 毫无怜悯 → 无情的

words.definition: n. 皱纹；褶；v. 起皱，皱起

examples.en: Deep wrinkles appeared around her eyes as she smiled.
examples.zh: 她微笑时眼角现出深深的皱纹。

examples.en: He wrinkled his brow, puzzled by the question.
examples.zh: 他皱起眉头，被这个问题难住了。

words.usage: 可数名词，皱纹：wrinkles around the eyes 眼角皱纹；动词起皱、皱起：wrinkle one's nose 皱鼻子、wrinkle one's brow 皱眉。派生 wrinkled 有皱纹的

confusables.note: v. 叮当响，无哑音 w
v. 争吵，同 wr- 词头

collocations: wrinkle one's brow 皱眉
iron out wrinkles 熨平褶皱；消除问题
fine wrinkles 细纹
words.mnemonic: wr(扭)+inkle：皮肤拧出褶 → 皱纹
